name: Madonna ~Kanjuku Body Collection~
source:
Huge breasts are justice! Mature women are my fantasy!

Why makes them so erotic?
Scattering their pheromones as they walk.
"Do as you please" is their catchphrase.

My body won't be able to last any longer if this continues everyday.
If that's the case I'll better move out of this apartment and start living the life of a proper student.
And the day I made up my mind on this, a new manager for the apartment arrived.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=716459]Getchu synopsis[/url]]
translation:
巨乳即正义！成熟女人就是我的幻想！

她们为什么如此色情？
走起路来，信息素四处飘散。
“随你喜欢”是她们的口头禅。

要是每天都这样，我的身体再也撑不住了。
既然如此，还是搬出这栋公寓，过一个正经学生该过的生活吧。
可就在我下定决心的当天，公寓来了一位新管理员。
